question: The value of (sin A-sin B)/(cos A+cos B)+(cos A-cos B)/(sin A+sin B) is :
solution:
**Given:**

The expression to simplify is:

(sin A - sin B) / (cos A + cos B) + (cos A - cos B) / (sin A + sin B)

**Formula used:**

We can use trigonometric identities to simplify the expression. Specifically, the sum-to-product identities:

sin A - sin B = 2 cos((A + B)/2) sin((A - B)/2)

cos A - cos B = -2 sin((A + B)/2) sin((A - B)/2)

cos A + cos B = 2 cos((A + B)/2) cos((A - B)/2)

sin A + sin B = 2 sin((A + B)/2) cos((A - B)/2)

**Calculations:**

First, applying the sum-to-product identities to the given expression:

⇒ (2 cos((A + B)/2) sin((A - B)/2)) / (2 cos((A + B)/2) cos((A - B)/2)) + (-2 sin((A + B)/2) sin((A - B)/2)) / (2 sin((A + B)/2) cos((A - B)/2))

Now, simplify both terms:

⇒ sin((A - B)/2) / cos((A - B)/2) - sin((A - B)/2) / cos((A - B)/2)

⇒ 0

**∴ The value of the given expression is 0.**
